config.recipe: CMN + frozen original H3 teacher + HR decoder-aware pixel supervision
config.initialization: Warm start from CMN best9500; fresh AdamW and cosine schedule
config.selection: Minimum mean dev RGB L1 + 0.2 LPIPS on fixed full-spatial native temporal regions, including step0
config.pixel_target: Frozen H3 decoder of HR reference latent; not teacher pixels
config.pixel_sampling: One full-spatial native block every4 updates, otherwise one native spatial tile interior; 4 LPIPS frames per region
config.temporal_pixel_scope: Non-crossfaded real RGB positions only; no synthetic tail RGB
config.padding: MSE/KD first36, eWarp35; token36 retained as decoder context and can receive pixel gradients
config.causal_scope: Causal latent upscaler only; frozen original decoder remains noncausal
config.test_reuse: Retained16 test +3 legacy, previously inspected; not a new blind test
config.loss_definition: 1 HR latent MSE + .25 teacher latent MSE + .1 eWarp + 1 RGB L1 + .2 LPIPS alex v0.1
